description: Search, read, create, and edit Kingsoft documents through the official Skill Hub MCP service after browser authorization.

actions.name: call_tool
actions.description: Execute a discovered upstream Kingsoft tool. Input shape: {"toolName":"create_folder","arguments":{"name":"Project Materials"}}. The outer selector is toolName, never name; business fields such as a folder name go inside arguments. Check the selected tool schema first and preserve its exact name. To inspect this connector action use get_action_guide({"actionId":"wps_mcp.call_tool"}), not get_tool_schema. Do not retry uncertain writes automatically.

toolName.description: Required outer selector for the upstream tool, e.g. create_folder. Do not rename this field to name.

arguments.description: Business arguments matching the selected tool's inputSchema. A folder's name belongs here as arguments.name, not in the outer input.

actions.name: get_tool_schema
actions.description: Get the business parameter schema for one upstream Kingsoft tool. Required input: {"toolName":"create_folder"}, replacing create_folder with the exact discovered name. Never pass {}. This does not inspect local connector actions such as wps_mcp.call_tool: use get_action_guide with that actionId instead. Tool names and prefixes must match discovery exactly.

toolName.description: Required upstream tool name returned by list_tools, e.g. create_folder; not the local action call_tool.

guidance.description: How to wrap business arguments in a connector execution request.

outputSchema.description: The selected official tool, including its full inputSchema.

actions.name: list_tools
actions.description: Search or browse a compact, paginated catalog of official Kingsoft MCP tools. Search list_my_files for root listing (我的云文档根目录) or list_files for folder children; preserve the exact name and prefix returned. Use get_tool_schema for exact parameters. Do not search local skills, configure mcporter, or guess tool names.

query.description: Optional keyword or exact tool name, such as list_my_files, directory, 目录 or sheet.

offset.description: Zero-based position in the filtered tool catalog. Defaults to 0.

limit.description: Number of compact tool summaries, from 1 to 20. Defaults to 10.

inputSchema.description: Search and pagination for official tools, not cloud files.

tools.description: Compact names and descriptions, without parameter schemas.

nextOffset.description: Next page offset, or null when complete.

guidance.description: How to retrieve parameters and call the selected tool.

outputSchema.description: The current Kingsoft MCP tool catalog.
